import numpy as np, collections
workspace=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace')
programs=workspace/'programs'; programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hlines = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    vlines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    row_bounds = [-1] + hlines + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + vlines + [w]
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            if r0 < r1 and c0 < c1:
                regions.append((r0,r1,c0,c1))
    sources = []
    for bounds in regions:
        r0,r1,c0,c1=bounds
        if any(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)):
            sources.append(bounds)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if sources:
        sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1=sources[0]
        pattern=[row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
        for r0,r1,c0,c1 in regions:
            if (r0,r1,c0,c1)==sources[0]:
                continue
            if r1-r0==len(pattern) and c1-c0==len(pattern[0]):
                for dr in range(r1-r0):
                    out[r0+dr][c0:c1]=pattern[dr][:]
    return out
'''
